meta.source: ufcstats.com via Greco1899/scrape_ufc_stats (data/raw/*.csv snapshot); built by tools/build_db.py
meta.notes: each side's S is decayed to the fight date and built only from earlier UFC fights; elo is pre-fight (see elo_report.json); result.time_s is seconds into the final round, fight_s total elapsed; cards are [A, B] per judge (order unknown for draws; omitted for no-contests, whose raw text stays in detail)
meta.corner: A is the first name in the ufcstats bout (usually the red corner). A won 56.3% of the 3178 decisive entries, so the engine and the metrics must treat the corners symmetrically (or average over the swap); never use the A/B position as a feature
meta.priors: shrink toward priors_asof[date[:4]][prior_division or division]: division rates from fights in the 5 years before Jan 1 of the entry's year, so no fight on or after that date leaks in. fighters.json / priors.json priors include every fight up to the snapshot (2024+ test fights among them) and are for live use only. prior_division is set for catch / open weight bouts: the heavier pre-fight home division of the two
